correctness.rationale: The labeled specialization t=-1 is exactly the eight-factor product, up to units. An independent finite-field replay found eight zero triple determinants in the quadratic integral model and norm one for the other 48; the zero triples share no pair and all reduced lines are distinct. This gives eight ordinary triples and four nodes in both characteristics. The local Tjurina length at a triple is four even in characteristic three: after a linear change and removing a unit take f=uv(u-v), and with w=u+v the Tjurina ideal is (uw,w²,u³), with basis 1,u,w,u². The node has length one. The replay reconstructed the cubic and quintic syzygies and primitive relation, dimensions [0,0,0,1,3,8] through coefficient degree five, all nine stated grevlex leaders and the exact all-degree numerator 1-3T^7+T^10+2T^12-T^13. The exhibited relation spans the relation module over the fraction field because U and B are independent; primitivity and unique factorization force polynomial multiples over S. The submodule presentation has the full Hilbert numerator, so its graded quotient in the full syzygy module vanishes; all differentials have positive-degree entries, giving minimality. Flat field extension preserves the result and minimality. The complex comparator follows from the cited nearly-free exponents (4,4) in Proposition 2.1 combined with Theorem 1.6, and its numerator is 1-3T^7+3T^11-T^12. Their difference is T^10(1-T)^3, so dimensions are 37 and 36 in degree ten and equal elsewhere. Supplied verify.py was inspected, not executed. Separate replay: branches/3201ff35-2dcd-45cd-be5c-f76b4ce78a4c/replay.py and replay.log. The calculation concerns only this model and the unsaturated homogeneous quotient.

evidence: Over F3 any point with z≠0 has x=0 or x=±z, so the original arrangement A covers it. At z=0 the only remaining projective direction is [1:-1:0]. Thus B=A∪{z=0} has empty complement and nine planes; A has eight planes and nonempty complement. By Yoshinaga, B is free with exponents (1,3,5), and A is not free since 8≥2·3.

In H={z=0}, all nine-plane restriction forms other than H reduce up to units to x, y, x-y, so |B^H|=3. By Abe, A has strictly plus-one exponents (1,3,5) and level 8-3=5. Definition 1.1 gives a unique minimal relation at degree 6 on the degree-1,3,5,5 derivation generators. Splitting off Euler gives AR(F) with degrees 3,5,5 and that relation; shifting by 7 yields the claimed Milnor resolution over F3, hence after scalar extension.

The two linear relation coefficients and one cubic are exactly the degrees forced by that presentation. The characteristic-zero numerator follows by the previously published nearly-free resolution, so the displayed isolated Hilbert jump is plain subtraction.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The approach gives the displayed Betti shifts and the Hilbert difference without computing a Gröbner basis, a new nonstandard theorem or a search-dependent negative inference. The only specific input beyond the existing theorems and published model is the evident completion by z=0 and its three distinct restriction lines.

originality.rationale: The stated characteristic-three minimal resolution, not merely its nonfreeness or low-degree Frobenius syzygy, is mechanically implied by existing finite-field freeness and free-deletion theorems. Adjoining z=0 covers all F3 points, and deleting it leaves a nonfree arrangement with a three-line restriction. Yoshinaga and Abe therefore directly give the exact graded shifts. The characteristic-zero comparator is already known; subtraction gives the degree-ten invariant without a new ingredient. No earlier exact MacLane table was located; direct implication is the decisive prior coverage.
residual_risks: An exact published characteristic-three table might exist outside the bounded searches. This does not undermine the positive coverage by explicit stronger theorems.
No assertion is made about other arithmetic models, other primes or priority for a particular certificate implementation.

value.rationale: The MacLane arrangement and its global-versus-local comparison are well motivated, and the independent computation is a useful reproducibility check. But the claimed exact invariant is already mechanically implied by stronger published results, with the characteristic-zero comparator already explicit. Recomputing that consequence by a different certificate does not constitute a separately valuable new finding under the exact-invariant standard; no nonroutine remainder is established.
